notes: Cross-footed twice.** The three recurrent titres sum exactly to the printed `Sous-total` (1,820,491,143) and the sous-total plus Titre 5 sums exactly to the printed `Total P.T.E.N` (15,150,773,643). · ⚠ This is a ministry envelope, not a digital line**, and it is recorded at `scope_confidence: partial` only because FY2024 is the one Congolese year in the corpus that publishes nothing finer. Article trente-huitième of the law presents programme budgets *à titre expérimental* for six pilot ministries — budget, économie et finances, plan, santé, enseignement préscolaire/primaire and enseignement technique — and Code 45 is not one of them. From FY2025 the whole budget is presented by programme and the digital record moves to programme 118, which is **not** comparable with this figure. · 86% of the vote is Titre 5 investissement**, and personnel is 0.8% of it — the reverse of the Congolese pattern in later years. · Read by geometry, not by text stream.** `pdftotext -layout` interleaves the two-column institution table and attaches figures to the wrong titre; the figures above were bound by `top` coordinate from `pdfplumber` characters. · `amount_usd` left blank.** `lookups/fx-imf-annual.csv` carries XAF only as a ball-park euro-peg derivation, not a named fiscal-year average from IMF IFS or the BEAC, and the driver forbids spot-converting a fiscal-year figure. · (Origin hold retired 2026-08-26: the `NOVEL` verdict no longer withholds a source's claims from the synthesis layer — see `wiki/origin-screen.md`. This page's claims are ordinary and may be cited and compiled like any other.)* · What was not established, and was not chased.** *Why* the secondary table differs is unknown, and the difference is not a simple mis-keying of one cell: its per-institution investment column sums to a stated XAF 461bn against 442.46bn in the gazette table as extracted here, and it counts 57 institutions to the gazette's 58. Its headline titre totals (dette 225bn, personnel 435bn, biens et services 190bn, transferts 548bn, investissement 461bn, autres 67bn = 1,926bn) do match `Article vingt-septième` of the law exactly. That is as far as it is worth going: the gazette is the instrument, and one dated statement of which figure is right is what the wiki needed.
